name: B10-0152/2025 (ECR, PfE) – Social and employment aspects of restructuring processes: the need to protect jobs and workers’ rights
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on social and employment aspects of restructuring processes: the need to protect jobs and workers’ rights
part_text:
This text is a request from a group of Members of the European Parliament, not a law. It asks the European Commission to review or pause Green Deal climate policies, to assess their social impact, and to cut rules on business. It also asks the Commission to reverse the planned ban on new petrol and diesel cars from 2035 and to soften the 2025 CO2 targets for carmakers.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of demands to the Commission.
- **Who it affects:** Car industry workers, small businesses, rural residents, and jobseekers needing new skills.
- **What happens next:** The Commission can accept, ignore or partly act on these requests.
